license_required.quote: Except as otherwise provided a person is guilty of a class 6 felony who, without a valid license or business entity registration as prescribed by this chapter: 1. Practices dentistry or any branch of dentistry as described in section 32-1202.

issuing_authority.quote: Board means the state board of dental examiners

name.quote: Board means the state board of dental examiners

type.quote: Board means the state board of dental examiners

degree_required.value: Doctor of Dental Medicine or Doctor of Dental Surgery
degree_required.quote: An applicant for licensure shall meet the requirements of section 32-1233 and shall hold a diploma conferring a degree of doctor of dental medicine or doctor of dental surgery from a recognized dental school

accrediting_body.value: American Dental Association Commission on Dental Accreditation
accrediting_body.quote: Recognized dental school means a dental school that is accredited by the American dental association commission on dental accreditation

exams.name: National Dental Board Examinations
exams.quote: An applicant for licensure shall have passed all of the following: The written national dental board examinations

exams.name: Clinical Examination
exams.quote: A clinical examination administered by a state or regional testing agency in the United States within five years preceding filing the application

interval_years.quote: a license expires thirty days after the licensee's birth month every third year

renewal_fee_usd.quote: every licensed dentist shall submit to the board a complete renewal application and pay a license renewal fee of not more than $650, established by a formal vote of the board

required.quote: A licensee shall include a written affidavit with the renewal application that affirms that the licensee complies with board rules relating to continuing education requirements

available.quote: The board by rule may waive the examination requirements of this article on receipt of evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has passed the clinical examination of another state or testing agency more than five years before submitting an application for licensure

requirements.value: Applicant must have passed clinical examination of another state or testing agency more than five years prior, maintain substantially equivalent licensure standards, meet minimum active practice hours, and complete continuing education requirements of jurisdiction where licensed
requirements.quote: The board by rule may waive the examination requirements of this article on receipt of evidence satisfactory to the board that the applicant has passed the clinical examination of another state or testing agency more than five years before submitting an application for licensure pursuant to this chapter and the other state or testing agency maintains a standard of licensure that is substantially equivalent to that of this state

national_association.quote: Recognized dental school means a dental school that is accredited by the American dental association commission on dental accreditation

regulatory_model.quote: Except as otherwise provided a person is guilty of a class 6 felony who, without a valid license or business entity registration as prescribed by this chapter: 1. Practices dentistry or any branch of dentistry as described in section 32-1202.

credential_type.quote: Issue licenses to persons who the board determines are eligible for licensure pursuant to this chapter

is_mandatory.quote: Except as otherwise provided a person is guilty of a class 6 felony who, without a valid license or business entity registration as prescribed by this chapter: 1. Practices dentistry or any branch of dentistry as described in section 32-1202.

title_protection.quote: Dentistry, dentist and dental mean the general practice of dentistry and all specialties or restricted practices of dentistry

scope_protection.quote: Except as otherwise provided a person is guilty of a class 6 felony who, without a valid license or business entity registration as prescribed by this chapter: 1. Practices dentistry or any branch of dentistry as described in section 32-1202.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in unprofessional conduct as defined in section 32-1201.01
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Unprofessional conduct as defined in section 32-1201.01

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or of a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude, in which case the record of conviction or a certified copy is conclusive evidence

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical or mental incompetence to practice dentistry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical or mental incompetence to practice pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing or aiding a violation of or noncompliance with any provision of the chapter or board rules
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing or aiding, directly or indirectly, a violation of or noncompliance with any provision of this chapter or of any rules adopted by the board pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dental incompetence as defined in section 32-1201
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dental incompetence as defined in section 32-1201

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally betraying a professional confidence or violating a privileged communication
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally betraying a professional confidence or intentionally violating a privileged communication except as either of these may otherwise be required by law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using controlled substances, narcotic drugs, dangerous drugs, marijuana, or hypnotic drugs to the extent affecting ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using controlled substances as defined in section 36-2501, narcotic drugs, dangerous drugs or marijuana as defined in section 13-3401, or hypnotic drugs...to the extent that it affects the ability of the dentist, dental therapist, denturist or dental hygienist to practice that person's profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Prescribing, dispensing or using drugs for other than accepted dental therapeutic purposes
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Prescribing, dispensing or using drugs for other than accepted dental therapeutic purposes or for other than medically indicated supportive therapy in conjunction with managing a patient's needs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing gross malpractice or repeated acts constituting malpractice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing gross malpractice or repeated acts constituting malpractice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Acting or assuming to act as a member of the board if not true
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Acting or assuming to act as a member of the board if this is not true

disciplinary_grounds.description: Procuring or attempting to procure a license by fraud, misrepresentation, or knowingly taking advantage of another's mistake
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Procuring or attempting to procure a certificate of the national board of dental examiners or a license to practice dentistry or dental hygiene by fraud or misrepresentation or by knowingly taking advantage of the mistake of another

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having professional connection with or lending one's name to an illegal practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having professional connection with or lending one's name to an illegal practitioner of dentistry or any of the other healing arts

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that a condition can be permanently corrected or corrected within a stated time if not true
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing that a manifestly not correctable condition, disease, injury, ailment or infirmity can be permanently corrected, or that a correctable condition, disease, injury, ailment or infirmity can be corrected within a stated time, if this is not true

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering to correct or treat a condition by secret means, method, device or instrumentality
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, undertaking or agreeing to correct, cure or treat a condition, disease, injury, ailment or infirmity by a secret means, method, device or instrumentality

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to divulge to the board the means, method, device or instrumentality used in treating a condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to divulge to the board, on reasonable notice and demand, the means, method, device or instrumentality used in treating a condition, disease, injury, ailment or infirmity

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dividing professional fees or receiving consideration for patient referrals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dividing a professional fee or offering, providing or receiving any consideration for patient referrals among or between dental care providers or dental care institutions or entities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly making false or fraudulent statements in connection with dental practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly making any false or fraudulent statement, written or oral, in connection with the practice of dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having a license refused, revoked, suspended, or disciplined in another jurisdiction unless board finds action not related to ability to practice safely
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having a license refused, revoked or suspended or any other disciplinary action taken against a dentist by, or voluntarily surrendering a license in lieu of disciplinary action to, any other state, territory, district or country, unless the board finds that this action was not taken for reasons that relate to the person's ability to safely and skillfully practice dentistry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing any conduct or practice that constitutes a danger to the health, welfare or safety of the patient or public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing any conduct or practice that constitutes a danger to the health, welfare or safety of the patient or the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a fee by fraud or misrepresentation, or filing a fraudulent claim with a third party
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a fee by fraud or misrepresentation, or wilfully or intentionally filing a fraudulent claim with a third party for services rendered or to be rendered to a patient

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing repeated irregularities in billing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing repeated irregularities in billing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employing unlicensed persons to perform work that can only be done by licensed persons
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Employing unlicensed persons to perform or aiding and abetting unlicensed persons in performing work that can be done legally only by licensed persons

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry under a false or assumed name
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry under a false or assumed name in this state, other than as allowed by section 32-1262

disciplinary_grounds.description: Causing or allowing supervised personnel to commit illegal acts or perform unauthorized operations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Wilfully or intentionally causing or allowing supervised personnel or auxiliary personnel operating under the licensee's supervision to commit illegal acts or perform an act or operation other than that allowed under article 4 of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Publishing false, fraudulent or misleading statements about skill, methods or practices
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Publishing or circulating, directly or indirectly, any false, fraudulent or misleading statements concerning the skill, methods or practices of the licensee or of any other person

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising in any manner that tends to deceive or defraud the public
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advertising in any manner that tends to deceive or defraud the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to dispense drugs and devices in compliance with article 6
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to dispense drugs and devices in compliance with article 6 of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with a board order including censure or probation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with a board order, including an order of censure or probation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with a board subpoena in a timely manner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with a board subpoena in a timely manner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing or refusing to maintain adequate patient records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing or refusing to maintain adequate patient records

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to allow board personnel to inspect place of practice and examine records
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to allow properly authorized board personnel, on demand, to inspect the place of practice and examine and have access to documents, books, reports and records maintained by the licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Refusing to submit to body fluid examination for substance abuse monitoring
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Refusing to submit to a body fluid examination as required through a monitored treatment program or pursuant to a board investigation into a licensee's alleged substance abuse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to inform patient of filling material type and reason for use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to inform a patient of the type of material the dentist will use in the patient's dental filling and the reason why the dentist is using that particular filling

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to report evidence of professional incompetence, unprofessional conduct, or impairment
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to report in writing to the board any evidence that a dentist, dental therapist, denturist or dental hygienist is or may be professionally incompetent, engaging in unprofessional conduct, impaired by drugs or alcohol, or mentally or physically unable to safely engage in activities

disciplinary_grounds.description: Filing a false report of misconduct to the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Filing a false report pursuant to paragraph 28 of this section

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing dentistry in an unregistered business entity
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing dentistry, dental therapy, dental hygiene or denturism in a business entity that is not registered with the board as required by section 32-1213

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing services or procedures as a dental therapist that exceed scope of practice or collaborative agreement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing services or procedures as a dental therapist that exceed the scope of practice or exceed the services or procedures authorized in the written collaborative practice agreement

definition_quote.value: the practice of dentistry is the diagnosis, surgical or nonsurgical treatment and performance of related adjunctive procedures for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of the human tooth or teeth, alveolar process, gums, lips, cheek, jaws, oral cavity and associated tissues of the oral maxillofacial facial complex, including removing stains, discolorations and concretions and administering botulinum toxin type A and dermal fillers to the oral maxillofacial complex for therapeutic or cosmetic purposes
definition_quote.quote: the practice of dentistry is the diagnosis, surgical or nonsurgical treatment and performance of related adjunctive procedures for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of the human tooth or teeth, alveolar process, gums, lips, cheek, jaws, oral cavity and associated tissues of the oral maxillofacial facial complex, including removing stains, discolorations and concretions and administering botulinum toxin type A and dermal fillers to the oral maxillofacial complex for therapeutic or cosmetic purposes

methods_authorized.quote: the practice of dentistry is the diagnosis, surgical or nonsurgical treatment and performance of related adjunctive procedures for any disease, pain, deformity, deficiency, injury or physical condition of the human tooth or teeth, alveolar process, gums, lips, cheek, jaws, oral cavity and associated tissues of the oral maxillofacial facial complex, including removing stains, discolorations and concretions and administering botulinum toxin type A and dermal fillers to the oral maxillofacial complex for therapeutic or cosmetic purposes

drug_authority.value: Dentists may prescribe and dispense drugs except schedule II controlled substances that are opioids, subject to board rules
drug_authority.quote: A dentist may dispense drugs, except schedule II controlled substances that are opioids, and devices kept by the dentist if

sedation_anesthesia_permit_types.quote: The board by rule shall require that a licensee obtain a permit for applying general anesthesia and sedation

sedation_permit_onsite_inspection_requir.quote: the board by rule shall require that a licensee obtain a permit for applying general anesthesia and sedation, shall establish and collect a fee of not more than $300 to cover administrative costs connected with issuing the permit and shall conduct inspections to ensure compliance

sedation_adverse_event_reporting_require.quote: If a death or an incident requiring emergency medical response occurs in a dental office or dental clinic during the administration of or recovery from general anesthesia or sedation by a qualified anesthesia provider, the treating dentist shall submit a report of the incident to the state board of dental examiners within seven business days after the occurrence

dental_hygienist_supervision_levels.quote:
Except as provided in subsections E,  F and I of this section,  a dental hygienist shall practice under the general supervision of a dentist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter.
E. A dental hygienist may practice under the general supervision of a physician who is licensed pursuant to chapter 13 or 17 of this title in an inpatient hospital setting.
F. A dental hygienist may perform the following procedures on meeting the following criteria and under the following conditions:
1. Administering local anesthetics under the direct supervision of a dentist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter after:...I. A dental hygienist may provide dental hygiene services under an affiliated practice relationship with a dentist as prescribed in section 32-1289.01.

collaborative_agreement_available.quote: A dentist who holds an active license pursuant to this chapter and a dental hygienist who holds an active license pursuant to this article may enter into an affiliated practice relationship to deliver dental hygiene services

collaborative_agreement_max_hygienists_p.quote: Not permit the provision of dental hygiene services by more than six affiliated practice dental hygienists at any one time

advanced_practice_permit_available.quote: A dental hygienist may provide dental hygiene services under an affiliated practice relationship with a dentist as prescribed in section 32-1289.01

value: health care organization or facility patients
public health agency or institution patients
public or private school authority patients
private nonprofit or charitable organization patients
social service organization or program patients
advanced_practice_eligible_patient_popul.quote: A contract for dental hygiene services with licensees who have entered into an affiliated practice relationship pursuant to this section may be entered into only by: 1. A health care organization or facility. 2. A long-term care facility. 3. A public health agency or institution. 4. A public or private school authority. 5. A government-sponsored program. 6. A private nonprofit or charitable organization. 7. A social service organization or program.

dental_therapist_license_available.quote: A person is deemed to be a practicing dental therapist if the person does any of the acts or performs any operations included in the general practice of dental therapists or dental therapy or any related and associated duties.

dental_therapist_collaborative_practice_.quote: A dental therapist may practice in this state either under the direct supervision of a dentist or pursuant to a written collaborative practice agreement

value: health center program with federal look-alike designation
nonprofit organization providing dental care to low-income and underserved individuals
private dental practice providing care for community health center patients of record
dental_therapist_practice_setting_restri.quote: A dental therapist may practice only in the following practice settings or locations, including mobile dental units, that are operated or served by any of the following: 1. A federally qualified community health center. 2. A health center program that has received a federal look-alike designation. 3. A community health center. 4. A nonprofit dental practice or a nonprofit organization that provides dental care to low-income and underserved individuals. 5. A private dental practice that provides dental care for community health center patients of record who are referred by the community health center.

mobile_dental_facility_registration_requ.quote: Beginning January 1, 2012, every mobile dental facility and, except as provided in subsection B, every provider, program or entity using portable dental units in this state must obtain a permit pursuant to this article

mobile_facility_followup_care_protocol_r.quote: Establish written protocols for follow-up care for patients who are treated in a mobile dental facility or through a portable dental unit. The protocols must include referrals for treatment in a dental office that is permanently established within a reasonable geographic area

dental_office_ownership_restrictions.quote: A business entity may not offer dental services pursuant to this chapter unless: 1. The business entity is registered with the board pursuant to this section. 2. The services are conducted by a licensee pursuant to this chapter.

opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: Dispensing a schedule II controlled substance that is an opioid

dental_laboratory_work_authorization_req.quote: "Dental laboratory technician" means any person, other than a licensed dentist, who, pursuant to a written work order of a dentist, fabricates artificial teeth, prosthetic appliances or other mechanical and artificial contrivances designed to correct or alleviate injuries or defects, both developmental and acquired, disorders or deficiencies of the human oral cavity, teeth, investing tissues, maxilla or mandible or adjacent associated structures.

denture_patient_identification_marking_r.quote: Every complete upper or lower denture fabricated by a licensed dentist, or fabricated pursuant to the dentist's work order, must be marked with the patient's name unless the patient objects. The marking must be done during fabrication and must be permanent, legible and cosmetically acceptable

teledentistry_authorized.quote: Teledentistry means the use of data transmitted through interactive audio, video or data communications for the purposes of examination, diagnosis, treatment planning, consultation and directing the delivery of treatment by dentists and dental providers in settings permissible under this chapter or specified in rules adopted by the board

hygienist_local_anesthesia_certification.quote: Administering local anesthetics under the direct supervision of a dentist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter after: The dental hygienist successfully completes a course in administering local anesthetics that includes didactic and clinical components in both block and infiltration techniques offered by a dental or dental hygiene program accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association. The dental hygienist successfully completes an examination in local anesthesia given by a state or regional testing agency in the United States. The board issues to the dental hygienist a local anesthesia certificate on receipt of proof that the requirements of subdivisions (a) and (b) of this paragraph have been met

hygienist_nitrous_oxide_certification_re.quote: Administering nitrous oxide analgesia under the direct supervision of a dentist who is licensed pursuant to this chapter after: The dental hygienist successfully completes a course in administering nitrous oxide analgesia that includes didactic and clinical components offered by a dental or dental hygiene program accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association. The board issues to the dental hygienist a nitrous oxide analgesia certificate on receipt of proof that the requirements of subdivision (a) of this paragraph have been met

restorative_function_endorsement_availab.quote: Except as provided in paragraph 14 of this subsection, those restorative functions permissible for an expanded function dental assistant if qualified pursuant to section 32-1291.01

interim_therapeutic_restoration_authoriz.quote: Placing interim therapeutic restorations after successfully completing a course at an institution accredited by the commission on dental accreditation of the American dental association

patient_record_retention_years.quote: If the patient is an adult, for at least six years after the last date the adult patient received dental services from that provider

cpr_certification_required_for_sedation.quote: A dental office or dental clinic at which general anesthesia or sedation is administered must contain properly operating equipment and supplies as prescribed by the board in rule and have proper emergency response protocols in place, including advanced cardiac life support and airway management and pediatric advanced life support, as applicable, when administering general anesthesia or sedation

dental_hygienist_alternative_practice_li.quote: A dental hygienist may provide dental hygiene services under an affiliated practice relationship with a dentist as prescribed in section 32-1289.01.
